activity_summary: At the door Anne said she had written don't come. You said her letter said come for harvest, and that the horse was dear. She looked at your feet and sat you down. She dressed two burst blisters with plantain leaf and mutton tallow, in a tub of cold well-water.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered her, and sat in the tub.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat you down and dressed the blisters.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the cloak, and told you to hold still.

facets.activity: Sat and let Anne dress the burst blisters

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thy letter said come for harvest

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Sit down before you fall down
